'''Arrow''' is the name of [[Birgitte Silverbow]]'s horse. 

==Appearance==
Arrow is a lean gray [http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gelding gelding].

==Activities==
Arrow carries Birgitte all throughout [[Caemlyn]] during the [[Succession Wars|succession]].{{ref/book|9|7}}{{ref/book|11|31}}{{ref/book|11|32}} Arrow also carries Birgitte to the meeting with the [[Borderlands|Borderlanders]].{{ref/book|9|27}}
